infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tezeon Courier needs your location to show you nearby delivery jobs and provide navigation to pickup and delivery points.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Tezeon Courier needs background location access to keep customers updated on their delivery status and ensure you receive nearby job notifications even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Background location is needed to track deliveries and update customers in real-time.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Tezeon Driver to use your location even when you are not using the app to track deliveries and receive nearby jobs.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Tezeon Driver to use your location in the background.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Tezeon Driver to use your location while using the app.

plugins.photosPermission: Tezeon Driver needs access to your photos to upload verification documents and vehicle photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: Tezeon Driver uses your camera to take verification documents and proof of delivery photos.
